# Dough Intent Coverage: saved pronunciations are hidden in Spelling review

**Verdict: Caught.**

**Story and revision.** SEED-124#save-pronunciations-as-note-properties ("Save pronunciations as note properties", `.planning/seeds/SEED-124-save-pronunciations-as-note-properties.md`; plan `.planning/slice-plans/001-save-pronunciations-as-note-properties/PLAN.md`), checked at revision 3a79a9d489.

**Promise.** "In Spelling review of that note, every place where the note body repeats a `pronunciation` value is hidden." Expected observable: the Spelling question stem shows `/.../` in each place where the body repeats a saved reading. The caller's suggested promise, fault location, and focused test class were validated against the story text and the revision and reused without change.

**Fault (one, scratch only).** `backend/src/main/java/com/odde/donut/algorithms/ClozeReplacement.java`, `maskPronunciationsAndTitles`: the saved-pronunciation pass was dropped. The statement

    String savedPronunciationsMasked = maskLiteralWords(TitleFragment.sortedLongestFirst(savedPronunciations), pronunciationsReplaced.toString(), internalPronunciationReplacement);

was replaced by `String savedPronunciationsMasked = pronunciationsReplaced.toString();`. Fixtures and assertions were left intact.

**Command (same for baseline, fault, and restored runs), run in the scratch clone.**

    unset SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL DB_URL SPRING_FLYWAY_URL
    CURSOR_DEV=true nix develop -c pnpm backend:test:worktree --tests 'com.odde.donut.controllers.RecallPromptSpellingStemMaskingControllerTest'

This is the documented single-class form from `docs/worktree-backend-tests.md` (the `.agents/skills/backend-testing/SKILL.md` text itself only gives the full-suite commands).

**Run observations.**

- Baseline at 3a79a9d489: BUILD SUCCESSFUL; the result XML shows 14 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped, and lists both `spellingQuestionHidesSavedPronunciationWhereTheBodyRepeatsIt()` and `spellingQuestionHidesEveryValueOfAHandAuthoredPronunciationList()` as executed.
- With the fault: BUILD FAILED; 14 tests completed, 5 failed. Reach and wrong behavior were observed in the stems the controller returned, as printed by the failed assertions:
  - `spellingQuestionHidesSavedPronunciationWhereTheBodyRepeatsIt` (line 133): expected `数や量が非常に大きいこと。「[...]（/.../）なるご迷惑」`, was `数や量が非常に大きいこと。「[...]（ただい）なるご迷惑」`. The saved reading ただい was shown to the learner.
  - `spellingQuestionHidesEveryValueOfAHandAuthoredPronunciationList` (line 152): expected `[...]（/.../）が悪い。[...]（/.../）を失う。`, was `[...]（かおいろ）が悪い。[...]（がんしょく）を失う。`. Both list values were shown.
  - Also failed on the same wrong behavior: `spellingQuestionHidesALongerSavedPronunciationBeforeAShorterOneItStartsWith` (line 160), `spellingQuestionHidesAOneKanaSavedPronunciationInsideOtherWords` (line 167), `spellingQuestionHidesBothASavedPronunciationAndASlashReadingInTheBody` (line 175).
  - The 9 other cases in the class passed, so the failure was not a general breakage.
- Restored: the file was copied back from a saved original, `cmp` reported it identical, `git status --short` and `git diff` in the scratch clone were empty at 3a79a9d489, and the same command gave BUILD SUCCESSFUL with 14 tests, 0 failures.

**Assertion that caught it.** The `assertThat(stemWithoutMarkTags(question), equalTo(...))` stem assertions in `backend/src/test/java/com/odde/donut/controllers/RecallPromptSpellingStemMaskingControllerTest.java`, first of all the one in `spellingQuestionHidesSavedPronunciationWhereTheBodyRepeatsIt` (line 133). The claim is limited to the observed path: the Spelling question stem produced through the recall-prompt controller for a note whose frontmatter holds a `pronunciation` value (single value and YAML list), with this one fault (the whole saved-pronunciation pass missing).

**Limits.** One fault only. Not probed: the alternative fault where `FrontmatterPronunciation.fromNoteContent` returns only the first list item, and the other candidate promise ("Being a `pronunciation` value does not make a text an accepted answer", `RecallPromptAnswerSpellingControllerTest.savedPronunciationIsNotAnAcceptedAnswer`). This check says nothing about them.

**Next proof action.** None needed for this promise against this fault: the maintained proof holds. If more confidence is wanted, the evidence supports a separate check of the accepted-answer promise with a fault that makes saved pronunciations accepted answers, because that case passed before the change and this probe did not exercise it.

**Prior disposition.** No already-planned repair or earlier disposition was matched; the probe causes no new repair decision.

**Scratch handling.** The scratch checkout was a local `git clone` of the worktree, detached at 3a79a9d489, at `/var/folders/65/16p4k5qj42qg7l46k2j0nhj40000gn/T/dough-intent-coverage.jSH5oA/checkout`. Its first test run allocated its own database `doughnut_wt_18329bd3940242a59c5c58428da15bf8_test`. Afterwards that database was dropped (it had no open sessions, and a schema lookup then returned 0), and the scratch directory was removed. A clone is a primary checkout, so `pnpm worktree:retire` does not apply to it; the database was dropped directly with the local root account instead. No linked worktree was added, and nothing was committed, pushed, stashed, reset, or cleaned.

**Cost.**

- **Test runtime.** Measured, from the runner: test suite time 22.5 s (baseline), 21.3 s (fault), 19.6 s (restored), 63.4 s in total, from the `time` attribute of the JUnit result XML. Gradle build time including migration and compilation: 1m 31s, 1m 9s, 1m 16s. Wall time of the three commands by shell `time`: 118.4 s, 82.9 s, 88.6 s, 289.9 s in total.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No human took part in the probe and no separate measure was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** 16 tool operations by one agent before the report finisher (measured by count; the finisher's printed body said 10, which was a miscount and is corrected here); token use is unavailable because the agent cannot read its own usage.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 409674 ms (measured), from 1794445216459 to 1794445626133 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

- Checked revision: 3a79a9d489 (product code equal to `main` at 12288107bd).
- Evidence: the worker report above; verdict Caught by `RecallPromptSpellingStemMaskingControllerTest`.
- Decision: no follow-up. The maintained proof catches the probed fault, and the report names no repair.
- Canonical follow-up links: none.
